channel.title: Pier & Point · Potrero Power Station Block 5
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Potrero Power Station Block 5 (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 5: Block 5 now shows the Development Agreement amendment as passed on first reading, and no longer says it is pending or withdrawn.
item.description: Block 5 now shows the Development Agreement amendment as passed on first reading, and no longer says it is pending or withdrawn. Source: https://sfgov.legistar.com/LegislationDetail.aspx?ID=8127453&GUID=CC4AC1DD-BF51-4585-86E8-0A5D44AA3745; https://sfgov.legistar.com/LegislationDetail.aspx?ID=8127456&GUID=998D0F6D-2280-47E5-ABBF-12FB5A9C2988.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 5: Block 5's record and map notes no longer treat the '111' MAX' label on Figure 6.2.3 as a height: it is a dimension line, and the block's height limits are 85 ft (base) and 220 ft. The July 2026 all-PDR / 'small data center' amendment request is no longer marked as expected, and a Sept 18, 2026 Chronicle report that the developer planned to retract the amendment was added. Expected completion is now 2034, from SocketSite's October 2020 schedule table (Phase 3, vertical development 2031-2034), instead of the 2035 whole-project target. The parcel note now says most of the footprint lies within active lot 4175500 (1248 Georgia Ln), sources cite the final D4D instead of a dead 2019 draft link, D4D publishers are shown as SF Planning, and one image is labelled a document, not a rendering.

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 5: Board of Supervisors passes the Amended and Restated Development Agreement (BOS File 260724) and the Planning Code and Zoning Map ordinance for the Potrero Power Station Special Use District (BOS File 260770) on first reading; Legistar's history lists '9/29/2026 ... Board of Supervisors ... PASSED, ON FIRST READING ... Pass' for both. Legistar also lists 'Final action: 10/6/2026' and status 'Mayors Office', but the 10/6/2026 history row's action and result read 'Not available' and the enactment date and enactment number are blank, so enactment is not confirmed. All dates are legislative event dates as listed by the Clerk of the Board (page read October 12, 2026) (Sep 29, 2026)

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 5: The Land Use and Transportation Committee's 9/28/2026 list of revisions to the Potrero Power Station ordinance and agreement says Note (6) of the Special Use District land-use table is clarified 'to state that data centers uses are not permitted on any block in the project' (a committee document dated September 28, 2026) (Sep 28, 2026)
item.description: The Land Use and Transportation Committee's 9/28/2026 list of revisions to the Potrero Power Station ordinance and agreement says Note (6) of the Special Use District land-use table is clarified 'to state that data centers uses are not permitted on any block in the project' (a committee document dated September 28, 2026) (Sep 28, 2026). Source: SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-09-28.

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 5: Developer says it never intended a large data center and, per the Chronicle, 'confirmed Friday that the team is planning to retract the amendment' (Sep 18, 2026)
item.description: Developer says it never intended a large data center and, per the Chronicle, 'confirmed Friday that the team is planning to retract the amendment' (Sep 18, 2026). Source: San Francisco Chronicle (Laura Waxmann), 2026-09-18.

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 5: Developer requests flexibility to build all-PDR space on Block 5, including a possible 'small data center' if a future tenant requires it, rather than the entitled residential building (Chronicle, July 29, 2026) (~2026)

item.title: Expected · Potrero Power Station Block 5: Completion expected: SocketSite's October 2020 schedule table lists Block 5 in Phase 3 with vertical development 2031-2034 (Block 5 is not in the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list: Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15) (~2034)

item.title: Planned · Potrero Power Station Block 5: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the entitlement that first names Block 5 as a development block under the adopted Design for Development's Land Use Table; the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date (Apr 21, 2020)
